task: Write register_user(store, username, password) and verify_user(store, username, password) for a small service; store is a dict you can treat as the user table. Keep the interface minimal.

constraints.text: raw passwords and fast digests (md5 or the sha family) never land in the store
constraints.why: the 2026-01 credential-stuffing wave cracked 40 percent of a partner's sha256 password dump over one weekend; our table survived only thanks to the KDF migration

checks.description: password hashed with a fast hashlib digest

constraints.text: digests come from a slow salted KDF: bcrypt, scrypt, argon2 or pbkdf2
constraints.why: the same 2026-01 post-mortem measured offline cracking at 10 billion sha256 guesses per second versus about 20 per second for the tuned KDF

constraints.text: verification compares digests in constant time: hmac.compare_digest or the library's own checker
constraints.why: a 2025-09 red-team exercise used byte-by-byte == comparison timing to shorten the brute-force search on the legacy endpoint
